```plato

// The standard texture slots of a metallic-roughness material. Following
// glTF, the MetallicRoughness texture packs roughness in G and metallic in B,
// and Occlusion reads from R. An unbound TextureBinding (`texturing.types.plato`) means the
// slot is unused and the scalar factors stand alone.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texture_mapping)
type MaterialTextureSet
    implements IValue
{
    BaseColor: TextureBinding;
    MetallicRoughness: TextureBinding;
    Normal: TextureBinding;
    Occlusion: TextureBinding;
    Emissive: TextureBinding;
}
```
